The instant petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed on behalf of
petitioners seeking quashing of Fir bearing no. 284/2020, Police Station Budh Vihar, Rohini,
Delhi, for the offences punishable under Section 498A/406/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Ipc
)
and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. Issue notice.
Mr. Anand V. Khatri, learned ASC (Crl.) accepts notice on behalf of the State.

sentences.text: Thereafter, disputes out of the wedlock initiated and led to institution of proceedings before the competent courts of law.
On 06.10.2020, respondent no. 2 filed a Domestic violence complaint against the petitioners.
On 02.11.2020, an FIR bearing no. 284/2020 was registered at Police Station Budh Vihar, Delhi, for the offences punishable under Section 498A/406/34 of IPC against the petitioners.
It is stated that on 18.10.2021, petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 signed an MOU as per which parties agreed to withdraw all pending cases against each other.

5. On a query made by this Court, respondent no.2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.
It is also stated by respondent no.2 that the entire dispute has been amicably settled between the parties vide Memorandum of Understanding (MoU ) dated 18.10.2021 entered into between them.

6. It is submitted that respondent no.2 has settled all her claims in respect of her dowry articles,
stridhan, marriage expenses, jewellery, gift items and claims of past, present and future maintenance and permanent alimony with petitioner No.1 and other family members.
7. Today, the complainant who is present in Court states that she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.

8. In view of the above facts that the parties have amicably resolved their differences out of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings, rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 14:22:35 justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

9. Accordingly, FIR bearing No. 284/2020, Police Station Budh Vihar, Rohini, Delhi, for the offences punishable under Section 498A/406/34 of the IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
10. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
